topic: A person's invention is already patented by someone else
text:
The rain's been hammering the city non-stop, and it's got me chained to this desk like a务实的侦探 won't let go. So, here's the story: this mark walks in, thinking he's the next Edison. Claims he's got this gizmo, something about generating power from thin air. Turns out, the patent office's already got a file an inch thick with someone else's name on it. 

Now, he's a jittery sort, hands fidgeting like they're playing an invisible piano. Keeps saying how he never saw the other guy's name on the blueprints, swears he's got witnesses. Sure, I've heard it all before. In this town, you've got to play it cool, but I can’t help but think there's more to this story than just a mistake. 

Going to have to dig around, ask some questions. See what turns up. This city, it doesn't give up its secrets easy. Not even in the rain.
